meta.title: AI Skills Registry
meta.description: A community-curated index of reusable AI skills — prompt-based instruction sets that extend any AI assistant's capabilities.

skills.name: Usage Limit Reducer
skills.author: Dubibubii
skills.tagline: Stop burning through tokens. Start working smarter.
skills.description: Diagnoses your Claude session, runs a real token-usage report from local JSONL logs, and applies 11 proven rules to cut usage — without losing productivity.
what_it_does: Runs a live token-usage report from ~/.claude project logs
Diagnoses conversation length, CLAUDE.md presence, and model selection
Applies 11 rules matched to your specific situation
Recommends concrete next actions (compact, clear, model switch)

skills.name: Code Reviewer
skills.author: community
skills.tagline: Deep, opinionated code reviews — like a senior engineer on your team.
skills.description: Structured code review skill that checks for correctness, security, performance, readability, and maintainability. Returns ranked issues with severity levels and fix suggestions.
what_it_does: Reviews code for bugs, security issues, and anti-patterns
Rates issues by severity (critical / warning / suggestion)

skills.name: Research Synthesizer
skills.author: community
skills.tagline: Turn scattered information into structured insight.
skills.description: Takes multiple sources, documents, or URL dumps and synthesizes them into a coherent report with key findings, conflicting views, open questions, and confidence scores.
what_it_does: Identifies main claims and themes across sources
Surfaces conflicts and consensus between sources
Assigns confidence level to each finding

skills.name: Prompt Engineer
skills.author: community
skills.tagline: Write prompts that actually work — for any AI.
skills.description: Meta-skill that helps you craft, iterate, and evaluate prompts. Applies chain-of-thought, few-shot, role-play, and constraint techniques and explains why each choice improves output.
what_it_does: Diagnoses why a prompt produces weak output
Generates 3 variants ranked by expected effectiveness
